title: Commercial Excellence and Brand Growth | GOP
description: GOP recovers margin through pricing and sales discipline, then builds brand and demand: positioning, content, search and AI visibility, measured on margin.

nodes.name: Commercial Excellence and Brand Growth
nodes.description: GOP first recovers margin already inside the order book by fixing pricing, discounts, key-account plans and the sales process. It then builds the brand and demand engine: clear positioning, answer-first content, search and AI-search visibility and channel strategy, with customer acquisition cost tracked against margin.

audience.audienceType: Promoter-led businesses, primarily INR 150-500 crore revenue, and their investors
